feeds.title: Creative Juices Arts Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the home of Creative Juices Arts and Chris Zydel. Come explore intuitive painting, creativity and art as healing transformation with me.

feeds.title: Mindful Art Studio
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Amy of Mindful Art Studio. I'm here to empower your inner artist to use art for self-expression and de-stressin! Make art, feel better. I call that creative self-care.

feeds.title: Laüra Hollick Blog
feeds.description: Laura Hollick is an Award-winning Artist, Shaman & Visionary Guide. She is the founder of Soul Art Studio Inc., a thriving business devoted to circulating love around the planet with creative inspiration. Laüra believes that each person's life is their soul's art and she approaches her own life as living, breathing art.

feeds.title: Adventures in Art Therapy
feeds.description: I am a registered, board certified, and licensed art therapist in the DC Metro area, and have been working in the field since 1999. I currently work with adolescents in a partial hospitalization program. I have also worked in home-based counseling and inner city ED school settings.

feeds.title: Art Therapy Resources Blog
feeds.description: Art Therapy Resources provides information about art therapy techniques as well as essential business resources to help you establish and grow your Art Therapy practice.

feeds.title: Art of Life Counselling
feeds.description: She is a Holistic Counsellor and Transpersonal Art Therapist. She provides one to one and group workshops, recovery from Trauma, grief and loss, anxiety and depression and jungian dream work. Mairead also works to improve community education to reduce mental health stigma.

feeds.title: SUNDRIP Art for Life
feeds.description: SUNDRIP - Art for Life is a site that expresses in every media possible an intimate look into the life of a person living with major trauma. The issues addressed in art and writing include Dissociative Identity Disorder, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder, Lupus and Chronic Regional Sympathetic Dystrophy. Despite these issues, I intend to move forward, through and out with honor, grace and creativity.

feeds.title: ArtLight Therapy & Studios
feeds.description: Counselor Joni Becker offers a path to healing through creativity.

feeds.title: Chrissy Foreman Blog
feeds.description: Behind the scenes of art practice, creative wellbeing classes, and art therapy studies. Authored by Chrissy Foreman, an Australian intuitive artist and wellbeing facilitator.

feeds.title: KinderArt Blog
feeds.description: The goal of Kinder Art has been and always will be, to make art lessons and educational information accessible to people around the world. In addition to the thousands of free art lesson plans, they offer printable activity pages, the art kitchen, educational links and articles, early childhood education resources and much more.

feeds.title: art prescription
feeds.description: Welcome to the Art Prescription! I am a nurse and an artist and part of my quest in life are to intertwine these passions. Art is healing. It boosts the immune system, eases pain and depression by increasing good brain chemicals, and can be a way to release emotions. Here you will find a dose of art! My hope is to provide a dose of art for anyone who needs it.

feeds.title: Mullumbimby Art Therapy
feeds.description: Claudia holds a Masters in Creative Arts Therapy (Miecat) and attended additional training in Attachment-based, Somatic and Trauma-informed approaches. Claudia has been running art therapy groups for different organizations for the past 12 years and has been teaching art therapy in tertiary education.

feeds.title: Psychology Today - Arts and Health
feeds.description: The integrative, reparative and restorative powers of the arts. Psychology Today covers all aspects of human behavior, from the workings of the brain to the bonds between people and the larger cultural forces that drive our most intimate decisions.

feeds.title: Creativity in Therapy
feeds.description: I'm Carolyn Mehlomakulu - an art therapist and psychotherapist. I started this blog so that I could share cerative resources with other mental health professionals, both art therapist and therapist that want to bring more art and creativity into their work.

feeds.title: Creativity in motion
feeds.description: Official blog of Artist, Registered Board Certified Art Therapist, and Trauma Consultant Gretchen Miller, MA, ATR-BC, CTC. Blogging and thoughts on how creativity, connection, and collaboration foster inspiration, energy, and empowerment in my relationships, life, work, and play.

feeds.title: Expressive Therapist Blog
feeds.description: I am an expressive arts therapist with a specialization in ecopsychology and depth psychology. My work is rooted in the belief that our creativity is a wellspring of our deepest sources of wisdom and organically guides us toward growth and healing.

feeds.title: Jennifer Kind-Rubin(JKR) - Creative Art Psychotherapy
feeds.description: Jennifer Kind-Rubin is a licensed and board certified Creative Arts Therapist. She has experience working with a diverse clientele, incorporating a range of creative approaches to best meet each individual's unique needs. Jennifer works within NYC's non-profits, providing services to high-risk teens. Through her blog she shares inspirations, creative approaches and artistic ideas.

feeds.title: Mbodied Arts Studio Blog
feeds.description: Mbodied Art Studio is a beautiful art studio in the Westminster area offering classes, workshops, art therapy groups, and special events. Here, you can learn to paint and draw while enjoying music and community. Each person is given plenty of room for their creative process, and the furniture is ready to receive paint splatters and spills. Because the instructors want to help you express yourself,

feeds.title: Inner Wisdom Art Therapy
feeds.description: Inner Wisdom Expressive Arts Therapist and Counsellor, Tracey Gramm, offers Expressive Arts workshops, one-on-one individual and group counseling.

feeds.title: Art Therapy Alliance
feeds.description: The Art Therapy Alliance embraces social media and connection on-line to promote art therapy, the work of art therapists, and build community. Organized by Gretchen Miller, MA, ATR-BC, the ATA website, LinkedIn groups, Facebook page, Pinterest, and more feature resources, groups, and more related to the field of art therapy worldwide.

feeds.title: Expressive Art Inspirations
feeds.description: This blog offers Creative Inspirations for Emotional Healing curated by Creative Therapist Shelley Klammer.

feeds.title: Art Therapy 365
feeds.description: Art Therapy Directives for 365 Days of the Year

feeds.title: Colors of Play
feeds.description: Colors of Play, LLC was started by Pamela Ullmann, MS, ATR-BC, ATCS, LCAT in 2009 to bring art therapy to the northern NJ area. Currently, Colors of Play provides services in the client's home, school, or other facility. We specialize in creating a program that meets the needs of each individual and family.
